# Phoenix Auto-Updater
> Standalone tool that keeps local Phoenix installations updated from GitHub.

## Project Structure
- Core: `phoenix_auto_updater.py` (main updater logic)
- Launcher: `run_updater.bat` (Windows double-click)
- Config: Reads `config.json` if present (repo_url, branch, check_interval, stable_window, log_file)

## Key Features
- Checks for updates every 5 minutes (configurable)
- Waits for 5 minutes of stable internet before updating
- Uses bare git mirror (minimal space, no conflicts)
- Preserves user config/notes/data — only updates code
- Notifies when update applied — restart Phoenix to use new version
- Runs in background, can auto-start at Windows login
- Zero dependencies beyond Python standard library + git
